answer: Gottfried Vanger died by drowning in 1965 after his daughter Harriet killed him. On August 7, 1965, Gottfried attempted to rape and strangle Harriet at his cabin; she escaped to the jetty, shoved him into the water, and used an oar to hold his head under until he died [E1]. Although the official account likely treated his death as an accident or suicide, Harriet revealed that her brother Martin witnessed the murder and subsequently blackmailed her into sexual slavery by threatening to expose her crime [E2][E3].
